commonRentalAliases: Tesla Short Range Model 3 or similar

cargoZones.label: Rear trunk behind second row
cargoZones.notes: Tesla publishes 21 cu ft (594 L) behind the second row for North American 2024+ Model 3. Rectangular planning dimensions and opening estimates are intentionally conservative because the sedan trunk includes non-rectangular side pockets and under-floor space.

seatBackEncroachment.notes: Default rear seat-back rake assumption for optional encroachment-aware cargo planning.

cargoZones.label: Front trunk / frunk
cargoZones.notes: Tesla publishes 3.1 cu ft (88 L) for the front trunk. Planning dimensions are approximate and favor soft bags, backpacks, and charge-cable storage.

cargoZones.label: Rear seat folded cabin extension
cargoZones.notes: Planning-only estimate for the additional pass-through area available when the split-fold rear seatbacks are folded. Tesla's published cargo-volume table for the current North American manual does not list a seats-folded cargo volume.

cargoZones.label: Rear passenger footwell overflow
cargoZones.notes: Generic overflow area for soft bags when one rear passenger position or footwell can be sacrificed; not a manufacturer cargo specification.

seatConfigurations.label: Rear seats up
seatConfigurations.notes: Uses Tesla's current North American published rear trunk and front trunk cargo volumes.

seatConfigurations.label: Rear seats folded
seatConfigurations.notes: For two occupants plus cargo; folded-seat and pass-through geometry varies by trim and cargo shape.

seatConfigurations.label: Rear seats up with rear footwell overflow
seatConfigurations.notes: Assumes at least one rear passenger position is used for soft luggage.
